To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the quality of human resources management in a public organization is a crucial factor for its modernization and the quality of services provided to citizens; (2) the quality of HRM depends on the ability of the organization to negotiate and concert with employees on work organization, work conditions and objectives; (3) the quality of the HRM is also a key factor for the success of the modernization of the organization.
the quality of HRM is an essential lever of the quality of services of an organization and of its capacity to modernize itself.
the quality of human resource management is a critical lever for the success of public organizations in the context of a new public management.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the issue of the quality of public services, and in particular with the role of human resource management (HRM) in the modernization of public services.
the question of how to improve the quality of public services in the context of the new management public.
the question of why agents who are often strongly committed to public service are not more spontaneously involved in the implementation of a modernisation process and an improvement of services.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the new management public, as well as the new public governance, require new regulations and a different approach to HRM.
the quality of the human resource management in an organisation is a key factor of the quality of the services provided by the organisation.

the study of the relationship between the quality of the management of human resources and the involvement of agents is essential to the quality of the services provided by public organizations and to their capacity to modernize themselves.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the new public management (NPM) is a new way of organizing public administration, which is a result of the political, economic and social changes of the last two decades of the twentieth century.

we are interested in understanding the nature of the social and psychological processes that underlie the development of the self, the development of the social world, and the interrelations between the two.
the new public management (NPM) has been the main driving force for the modernization of the public sector in France.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the new public management is a challenge that is not easy to implement, especially when the agents of a public organization have a strong attachment to public service.
a key lever of the quality of services in a public organization and its capacity to modernize itself is the quality of its human resources management and the implication it creates among employees.
the quality of the HRM system and the involvement of the employees are essential to the success of the quality services provided by public organizations.
